visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of an open pop-up book rests on a warm-toned wooden surface. The book displays a detailed savanna scene with 3D miniature animals including a textured grey rhinoceros and a small hippopotamus. The trees are made of a fuzzy, green wool-like material. A human finger enters from the right and gently strokes the rhinoceros's horn. The lighting is soft and warm, suggesting a cozy indoor environment with a blurred, nondescript background. (2) The scene cuts to a different page of the pop-up book featuring a tall, orange-and-brown giraffe, a baby elephant, and a small lion cub standing amidst dense green trees and red mushrooms. A human finger reaches down from the top of the frame to touch the giraffe's head and the elephant's trunk. The camera remains static, focusing on the tactile interaction between the person and the intricate paper and fabric craft elements.
